title: Left refinement comparisons and their complete adjunction mate records
statement: For the given prime l, independent-universe closure Omega, finite-field datum D, finite-type geometric map f, compactifications c,d and refinement r, and prescribed Transport records A,B of def-sf-exceptional-refinement-transport-data, LeftMates contains only the left natural isomorphism at each coefficient stage, its integer-shift compatibility, the open-unit ring normalization and the left rational/common-field conjugation formulas. Mates contains the complete refinement comparison with its unit/counit equations, left/right shifts, the two explicit transpose formulas and both left and right rational/common-field conjugation formulas. The ring predicate and conjugate refinement construction are exactly the published ones. Neither record constructs or chooses an existence witness.

proof.text: Package the displayed maps and equations in records. The left-only record refers to the existing proved conjugate-completion helper solely to state the same left ring normalization. No right comparison or system realization is supplied by LeftMates.
